alcance: Terminología y traducciones revisadas en contexto. Las reglas detectan errores concretos; no certifican equivalencia semántica completa ni validación experimental. El original se conserva.

fuentes.uso: Certeza GRADE, dominios de evaluación e intervalos de confianza. La certeza de la evidencia no es la confianza estructural de AlphaFold.
Biomarcador de respuesta, actividad farmacodinámica y target engagement; no equivalen por sí solos a eficacia clínica.
Distinguir biomarcador, desenlace sustituto y beneficio clínico.
En este proyecto, reproducir análisis publicados con los datos originales es computational reproducibility. Replication exige datos de un estudio independiente.
Gapmer, DNA gap, wings, hybridization, target transcript, gene knockdown y efectos fuera de diana.
Afinidad de las alas y corte del ARN por RNase H1 en la región de la brecha de ADN.
Conservar los símbolos y distinguir el gen de su producto proteico.
pLDDT expresa confianza local en una predicción; no es una medición experimental ni certeza GRADE.
Una magnitud mostrada en g/mol se etiqueta como molar mass, no como peso genérico.
Pre-mRNA y hepatotoxicidad estudiada en ratones: RNase H1 degrada el ARN del híbrido con ADN, no el oligo de ADN.
RNAplfold calcula probabilidades locales de emparejamiento y de regiones no emparejadas. Es una predicción computacional, no un ensayo físico ni una medida de potencia.
Bench y desarrollo translacional: laboratorio a clínica. Banco en el contexto experimental no es una entidad financiera.
Cell viability se refiere a células viables y no a factibilidad de ejecutar un estudio (feasibility). Cada ensayo necesita caracterización para su modelo.

traducciones.Abierta: {superadas} de {requeridas} aná: Open: {superadas} of {requeridas} published analyses reproduced. ROSA2018 can now make discoveries with data.
traducciones.Antes de descubrir nada con datos, ROSA2: Before discovering anything from data, ROSA2018 has to reproduce already published analyses within a tolerance fixed in advance. If it fails, a new result cannot be told apart from a pipeline error. A person can waive this by leaving the reason; it is recorded as a policy change.
traducciones.Análisis publicados a reproducir antes d: Published analyses to reproduce before discovering
traducciones.Cada método dice qué puede evaluar, dónd: Each method states what it can assess, where it applies, what it needs, how it was validated and what state it is in. Popularity does not make it suitable; validation does. The reproducibility gate marks analysis methods as tested in context. A predictor does not validate its own training data.
traducciones.Calidad mide si el juez acierta y cuanto: Quality measures whether the judge gets it right and what each decision costs. Settings holds the autonomy dial, the policies and log integrity. Objective and data holds the mission, the datasets with their provenance record and what the lab knows.
traducciones.Con la escala que usa el resto del secto: On the scale the rest of the field uses (Beal and Rogers 2020; the 2025 review of autonomous labs says most sit at level 3 and none in production goes beyond 4). ROSA2018 operates at level 2 and states this in every dossier: it proposes hypotheses, plans and protocols and runs in silico analyses; every decision that touches the real world is made by a person. The autonomy dial above does not raise this level: it adjusts how much it asks within it.
traducciones.El expediente con el que la hipótesis sa: The dossier the hypothesis takes into the lab, in seven parts: whether it goes ahead or not and why (blockers), the full hypothesis with its version, the evidence with provenance, the analyses with data, the decisions, the preregistered protocol and what each outcome teaches you. It is assembled without any model, from what is in the state.
traducciones.Evaluaciones costosas (análisis con dato: Expensive evaluations (analyses with data) per run
traducciones.La puerta de reproducción está bloqueada: The reproducibility gate is locked ({superadas} of {requeridas}): until it is opened, no analysis with data counts as a discovery.
The reproducibility gate is locked ({v} of {v2}): the analysis will stay as "not run" until the published analyses are reproduced or the gate is waived with a reason.
traducciones.Lecciones generadas por regla al cerrar: Lessons generated by rule when each iteration closes: steps that failed, queries that yielded nothing, databases that did not respond, hypotheses closed by the Killer and why, ideas withdrawn from the nursery, analyses with no effect. Every step reads them before acting; a repeated lesson weighs more.
traducciones.Los resultados de evoke y evoke+ cuando: The evoke and evoke+ results when they are published; the GFAP analyses in GLP-1 trials in diabetes.

traducciones.Producto de los e-valores (kappa p^(kapp: Product of the e-values (kappa p^(kappa-1)) of the valid analyses. It controls type I error even as more tests keep being added (Popper, 2025).
traducciones.Antes de descubrir nada, ROSA2018 tiene: Before discovering anything, ROSA2018 has to reproduce three already published analyses within a tolerance. If it cannot, a new result is indistinguishable from a bug.
traducciones.Si la evidencia que se cita sostiene de: Whether the evidence cited really supports the hypothesis. A rule over the record decides it, not a model: claims their source does not support or whose citation does not resolve, retracted sources, analyses ruled not valid, or a Killer discard. A hypothesis without soundness loses its tournament match without any model judging it. Something being unverified does not remove soundness: that is "could not check".

traducciones.son el hueco de ADN: lo único que la RNa: form the DNA gap, which supports RNase H1-mediated cleavage of the paired RNA. Select a pair or move between pairs with the keyboard arrows.

traducciones.Un oligonucleótido antisentido es una ca: An antisense oligonucleotide is a strand of {secuencia} nucleotides that hybridizes with a region of the {simbolo} messenger RNA. With these gapmers, a cellular enzyme, RNase H1, cleaves the paired RNA. Without that RNA, new protein cannot be produced from it.
traducciones.Sale de RNAplfold (modelo de Turner, Vie: Calculated with RNAplfold (Turner model, ViennaRNA), a standard method. It models an isolated RNA strand; in the cell, RNA-binding proteins can make sites more or less accessible. Its correlation with experimental potency is described as moderate, not perfect.
traducciones.Se calcula con RNAplfold (modelo de Turn: Calculated with RNAplfold (Turner model, ViennaRNA), which estimates local RNA accessibility. This is a computational prediction, not a test-tube experiment. The model does not include RNA-binding proteins, which can change RNA accessibility in the cell. This prediction does not measure oligonucleotide potency or validate activity in cells.
traducciones.El cribado mira el ARN ya empalmado. El: The screen examines spliced mRNA. Promiscuous RNase H1-mediated cleavage of pre-mRNA is the known mechanism of hepatotoxicity described for high-affinity gapmers (Burel et al., Nucleic Acids Res 44:2093, 2016), and this is NOT assessed here. It requires the genome and its annotation, not the transcriptome.
traducciones.El cribado mira el ARN mensajero ya empa: The screen examines spliced messenger RNA. RNase H1-dependent off-target degradation of long pre-mRNA transcripts was studied as a mechanism of hepatotoxicity for some high-affinity gapmers in mice (Burel et al., Nucleic Acids Res 44:2093, 2016). That risk is NOT assessed here. It requires the genome and its annotation, not just the spliced-RNA transcriptome.
traducciones.La vista de programa de ROSA2018: lo que: ROSA2018's program view: what the research contributes to the whole, not to a single hypothesis. Four pieces, computed by rule at the close of each iteration. Learning: whether the predictions ROSA2018 wrote down before looking at the data (preregistration) were right, how long each hypothesis takes to receive a decision, and whether what is inherited from other research is reused. Therapeutic development pathway map: for each target, which of the eight steps between a mechanism and a benefit to a person are covered. Disease map: where the evidence falls by stage, brain region and cell type, and which gaps the mission names. Program datasets: the public datasets ROSA2018 found, with their access. Fields that have not been computed yet say so.
traducciones.Paso de la ruta terapéutica en el que es: Step of the therapeutic development pathway the hypothesis is at (mechanism, intervention options, target engagement, functional effect, selectivity, exposure, replication, evidence in the population). A completed cell campaign does not complete the development pathway.
traducciones.Ruta terapéutica evaluada por regla sobr: Therapeutic development pathway assessed by rule over the evidence it has: steps covered out of eight and the first one missing. The step the card declares is consistent with what is covered.
Therapeutic development pathway assessed by rule over the evidence it has: steps covered out of eight and the first one missing. The step the card declares is ahead of what the evidence covers.
traducciones.Paso de la ruta terapéutica: Step of the therapeutic development pathway
traducciones.Cada columna es un paso de la ruta terap: Each column is a step of the therapeutic development pathway: the eight steps that separate a mechanism from a benefit to a person. Hover over the step name to read what it checks. In each cell, how many live hypotheses for that target cover the step; in gray, the steps none covers.
traducciones.Se comprueba si hay datos cada 10 minuto: It checks for data every 10 minutes, with at least six hours between cycles and never while a run is in progress. Cases are split by investigation; the final evaluation (at least 8 cases, two assessments by the judge per case) requires a mean improvement of 0.05 with no case clearly worse. Every earlier version is kept. The Killer and the judge do not self-train on their own verdicts. Prompts and responses are stored with secrets redacted in the private log, not on this screen. Pausing prevents new promotions; a request already sent to the Gateway may still finish.
traducciones.Tipo fuera del vocabulario cerrado (comp: Type outside the closed vocabulary (target engagement, viability, function or mechanism, biomarker, safety); the list of what the contract is missing says so.
traducciones.Un fichero de instrucciones por método (: An instruction file per method (how to reproduce an analysis using GEO data, how to compute a sample size, how to do single-cell quality control). ROSA2018 loads the ones that match the plan and passes them to the model along with the modules the sandbox can import. You add or change them by editing rosa/skills/; the catalog is read at startup.
